title: Extremely basic AI prompt cracks decades-old maths problem | New Scientist
description: For the second time in a week, a long-standing conjecture has been disproved by artificial intelligence, highlighting the advanced mathematical capabilities of ChatGPT and its ilk
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Can sounds make plants grow bigger? A start-up says they can | New Scientist
description: Haivya has developed acoustic signals designed to influence plant development, and its trials reportedly show large yield increases in soybean, pepper and cannabis crops
author: Vanessa Bates Ramirez

title: Fields medal 2026: Work on unifying laws of physics wins maths prize | New Scientist
description: Mathematicians who helped unify laws of physics and cracked decades-old problems in geometry are among this year's recipients of the Fields medal
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Dark energy doesn't exist, claims controversial paper | New Scientist
description: An analysis of supernovae argues that the universe’s expansion is not speeding up, so there is no need for dark energy to exist to explain it
author: Matt von Hippel

title: Orcas filmed making sunfish explode by ramming them at high speed | New Scientist
description: Orcas have been seen smashing into sharp-tail sunfish so hard that the fish bursts into thousands of fragments, perhaps as a form of play as well as food processing
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: Why open-source software can be both good and bad | New Scientist
description: Software that is free to use creates many opportunities – not all of which are good
author: New Scientist
